summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated August 26, 2026, which discloses routine transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMR). CEO Tadeu Marroco and his closely associated person Luciana Franco Do Amaral acquired 250 ordinary shares at £42.890887 per share on August 25, 2026, solely through reinvestment of dividend income. The transaction, totaling £10,722.72, occurred on the London Stock Exchange. This is a routine PDMR dealing notification under UK market abuse rules, equivalent to a Form 4 under US rules, and does not constitute a special situation. No strategic action, deal terms, or board recommendation are involved.
